```{r}
#import dataset and necessary libraries 
data <- read.csv('assignment2026.csv')
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
str(data) #examine structure of dataset 
sum(!complete.cases(data)) #counts # of NAs 
table(data$treat1) #look at split of treatment 1
table(data$treat2) #look at split of treatment 2
table(data$death) #look at split of deaths 
```

## Section 1 -- descriptive statistics and exploratory analysis

```{r}
#examine the percentage of deaths between each of the treatment combinations 
table_clean <- data %>% 
  group_by(treat1, treat2) %>% 
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    Deaths = sum(death),
    `Death (%)` = round(100 * mean(death), 3),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

table_clean <- table_clean %>%
  mutate(
    treat1 = recode(treat1,
                    "L" = "Low",
                    "M" = "Medium",
                    "N" = "None"),
    treat2 = recode(treat2,
                    "Y" = "Yes",
                    "N" = "No"))

print(table_clean)
```

```{r}
#compare age and gender distribution between deaths and survived
#compare age
data %>% 
  ggplot(aes(age, y = after_stat(density), fill = factor(death))) + geom_histogram() + facet_wrap(~ death)+
  labs(title = 'Age Distributions By Mortality Status',
       x = 'Age',
       y = 'Density') +
  scale_fill_discrete(
  name = "Survival Status",
  labels = c("Survived", "Died"))

#compare gender
data %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(death), fill = gender)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = c("0" = "Survived",
               "1" = "Deaths")) +
  labs(x = "Outcome",
       y = 'Count',
       title = 'Survival Outcomes by Gender') +
  scale_fill_discrete(
  name = "Gender",
  labels = c("Female", "Male"))
  
```

```{r}
#compare consciousness level, symptoms after waking, atrial fib, CT scan, infarction, heparin, asparin, and stroke subtype between deaths and survived
variables_to_plot <- c('consc', 'wakesym', 'atrial', 'CT', 'Infarc', 'hep24', 'asp3', 'subtype')

for (var in variables_to_plot) {
  p <- data %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = .data[[var]], fill = factor(death))) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    title = paste("Mortality Proportion by", var),
    x = var,
    y = "Proportion",
    fill = "Outcome"
  )
  
  print(p)
}
```

```{r}
#proportion of deaths for the presence of each symptom 
symptom_vars <- c("symptom1", "symptom2", "symptom3", "symptom4", 
                  "symptom5", "symptom6", "symptom7", "symptom8")

#put each symptom in its own row 
data_long <- data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(symptom_vars), 
               names_to = "symptom", 
               values_to = "present")

data_long %>%
  filter(present == "Y") %>%  
  ggplot(aes(x = symptom, fill = factor(death))) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  labs(title = 'Mortality Proportion by Symptom',
       x = 'Symptom',
       y = 'Proportion'
  )+
    scale_fill_discrete(
  name = "Survival Outcome",
  labels = c("Survived", "Died"))

#correlation between symptoms 
library(ggcorrplot)

#relevel symptoms to be numeric 
data_symp <- data %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(symptom_vars),
                ~ ifelse(. == "Y", 1, 0)))

ggcorrplot(cor(data_symp[,symptom_vars]))
```

```{r}
#obtain training and validation sets 
library(caret) 

psamp <- .2 #set proportion 
set.seed(20)
n <- nrow(data)
testind <- sample.int(n, psamp * n)
datatr <- data[-testind,] #obtain training data set
dataval <- data[testind,] #obtain validation data set 
```

## Section 2 -- regularized regression

```{r}
# Extract data as matrices
library(glmnet)
x <- model.matrix(death ~ . - 1, datatr)
y <- datatr$death

#find optimal lambda
set.seed(20)
lasso.cv <- cv.glmnet(x,y,alpha=1,family="binomial",
                    standardize = TRUE,
                    type.measure = 'deviance', 
                    nfolds = 10)
plot(lasso.cv)
bestlambda <- lasso.cv$lambda.min
print(bestlambda)

#refit lasso with best lambda
lasso.mod <- glmnet(x,y,alpha=1,family="binomial",
                  lambda=bestlambda,standardize = TRUE)

#examine regression coefficients with best lambda
lasso_coefs <- lasso.mod$beta 
print(bestlambda)

```

```{r}
#clean up coefficient matrix (for presentation)
lasso_coefs_df <- as.data.frame(round(as.matrix(coef(lasso.mod)), 4))
lasso_coefs_df$Variable <- rownames(lasso_coefs_df)
rownames(lasso_coefs_df) <- NULL
colnames(lasso_coefs_df)[1] <- "Coefficient"
print(lasso_coefs_df)


```


```{r}
x_val <- model.matrix(death ~ . - 1, dataval)
y_val <- dataval$death

problasso <- predict(lasso.mod, newx = x_val, type = "response")

pred_class <- ifelse(problasso > 0.5, 1, 0)

#make both factors with same levels
pred_factor <- factor(pred_class, levels = c(0, 1),
                      labels = c("Survived", "Death"))
y_val_factor <- factor(y_val, levels = c(0, 1),
                       labels = c("Survived", "Death"))

#make confusion matrix
lassocmat <- confusionMatrix(pred_factor, y_val_factor, positive = "Death")
print(lassocmat)
```


```{r}
#look at variable importance
lassoimp <- coef(lasso.mod)
lasso10 <- lassoimp[-1,] %>%  abs() %>%  sort(dec = T) %>% head(10)
print(lasso10)
```

```{r}
#clean up top variables (for presentation)
lasso10 <- lasso10 %>% as.data.frame()
lasso10
```

## Section 3 -- Tree based method
```{r}
library(xgboost)
#set up variables 
X_train <- model.matrix(death ~ . - 1, datatr)
Y_train <- datatr$death

X_val <- model.matrix(death ~ . - 1, dataval)
Y_val <- dataval$death
Y_train_numeric <- as.numeric(as.character(datatr$death))

#create matrix for xgboost
xgdata <- xgb.DMatrix(data = X_train, label = as.numeric(Y_train_numeric))

#tune the number of iterations and max depth 
set.seed(20)
max_depth_values <- c(3, 4, 5, 6, 8)
depth_results <- data.frame()

for(depth in max_depth_values) {
  
  params <- list(
    objective = "binary:logistic",
    eval_metric = "logloss",
    max_depth = depth  
  )
  
  #cross validation - 10-fold 
  xgcv <- xgb.cv(
    data = xgdata,
    params = params,
    nrounds = 500,
    nfold = 10, 
    verbose = FALSE
  )
  
  #extract best results for best max_depth
  best_iter <- which.min(xgcv$evaluation_log$test_logloss_mean)
  best_logloss <- min(xgcv$evaluation_log$test_logloss_mean)
  
  #store results in data frame
  depth_results <- rbind(depth_results, data.frame(
  max_depth = depth,
    best_nrounds = best_iter,
    cv_logloss = best_logloss
  ))
  
}

print(depth_results)

#find best max_depth, nrounds, and logloss 
best_depth <- depth_results$max_depth[which.min(depth_results$cv_logloss)]
best_nrounds <- depth_results$best_nrounds[which.min(depth_results$cv_logloss)]
best_logloss <- min(depth_results$cv_logloss)

#reset params
params_best <- list(
  objective = "binary:logistic",
  eval_metric = "logloss",
  max_depth = best_depth)

#redo cross validation with best parameters
xgcv_best <- xgb.cv(
  data = xgdata,
  params = params_best,
  nrounds = 500,
  nfold = 10,
  verbose = FALSE
)

#plot the loss function
plot(test_logloss_mean ~ iter, data = xgcv_best$evaluation_log, 
     col = "darkgreen", 
     type = "b", pch = 16, 
     ylab = "Test Log-Loss", 
     xlab = "Iteration", 
     xlim = c(0, 100),
     main = paste("Cross-Validation (max_depth =", best_depth, ")"))
abline(v = best_nrounds, lty = 2, col = "red", lwd = 2)
text(best_nrounds, par("usr")[3] + 0.01, 
     labels = paste("Best:", best_nrounds), 
     pos = 4, col = "red")

#refit final model with optimal parameters 
xgb_final <- xgb.train(
  data = xgdata,
  nrounds = best_nrounds,
  params = params_best,  
  verbose = FALSE)
```


```{r}
#get predictions
probxgb <- predict(xgb_final, X_val)

#convert to factor with labels
predxgb <- factor(probxgb > 0.5, 
                  levels = c(FALSE, TRUE),
                  labels = c("Survived", "Death"))

#change values to factor
Y_val_factor <- factor(Y_val, 
                       levels = c(0, 1),
                       labels = c("Survived", "Death"))

#make confusion matrix
xgbcmat <- confusionMatrix(predxgb, Y_val_factor, positive = "Death")
print(xgbcmat)
```


```{r}
#assess variable importance 
xgbimpmat <- xgb.importance(model = xgb_final)

xgbimpmat %>%
  head(10) %>%
  select(Feature, Gain)

```
 

## Section 4 -- Comparision of methods 
```{r}
#comparision of predictions of validation sets (makes a table)
knitr::kable(data.frame(
  Model = c("Lasso", "XGBoost"),
  Accuracy = sprintf("%2.2f %%", c(lassocmat$overall["Accuracy"], 
                                    xgbcmat$overall["Accuracy"]) * 100),
  Sensitivity = sprintf("%2.2f %%", c(lassocmat$byClass["Sensitivity"], 
                                       xgbcmat$byClass["Sensitivity"]) * 100),
  Specificity = sprintf("%2.2f %%", c(lassocmat$byClass["Specificity"], 
                                       xgbcmat$byClass["Specificity"]) * 100)
))

```

```{r}
#comparison of variable importance 
#lasso top 10
lasso_top10 <- lassoimp[-1,] %>% abs() %>% sort(decreasing = TRUE) %>% head(10)
lasso_vars <- names(lasso_top10)

#xgboost top 10
xgb_vars <- head(xgbimpmat$Feature, 10)

knitr::kable(data.frame(
  Rank = 1:10,
  Lasso = lasso_vars,
  XGBoost = xgb_vars
))

```
